description: Rick Astley – Never Gonna Give You Up (1987) UK 7" single cover (Wikimedia)
rationale: Canonical image of the most-rickrolled resource on the web; embedded across millions of independent pages as the definitive internet meme, making its cache presence uninformative about any individual user.

The official in-browser build of Tailwind CSS, the script Tailwind's docs give for using it without a build step. Pinned versions of it are embedded by large numbers of unrelated prototypes, demos, and small sites, so its cache presence says nothing about an individual user.
